latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with full-featured daily report generation, export, and template support.

- Generates formatted daily reports by extracting tasks from memory or user input
- Supports exporting reports in plain text, Markdown, and Word (.docx) formats
- Configurable with custom templates and output options via JSON config
- Includes command-line scripts for report generation and packaging
- Multilingual interface with user prompts in both English and Chinese
